audience: landlords and property managers who run tenants, rent and maintenance in PropManagement

useCases.title: Review properties and tenants
useCases.text: List the properties of the organization. List the tenants of one property and open one tenant to see its details.

useCases.title: Check rent payments
useCases.text: List the rent payments recorded in the organization. Open one payment for its details.

useCases.title: Triage tenant maintenance requests
useCases.text: List the tenant maintenance requests and open one to read its details. Then list the scheduled maintenance tasks.

useCases.title: Review vendors and work orders
useCases.text: List the service vendors and open one vendor. Then list the work orders.

useCases.title: Check tenant documents and rental listings
useCases.text: List the tenant documents. The tool returns metadata only, not document contents. List the rental listings and open one listing.

useCases.title: Add or update properties and tenants
useCases.text: Create or update a property with its name, address and type. Create or update a tenant with its name, email, property and monthly rent. Updates send only the fields you set.
